description: Defines an abstract class 'Aggregator' for user-defined aggregations in Spark SQL, including example usage and methods for reduction, merging, encoding, and conversion to column.

classes.name: Aggregator
classes.description: Abstract class for user-defined aggregations in Spark SQL, parameterized by input, buffer, and output types, with methods for zero value, reduction, merging, finishing, encoding, and conversion to column.

methods.name: zero
methods.description: Returns the zero value for the aggregation.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Combines two buffer values with an input to produce a new buffer value.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges two buffer values into one.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Transforms the buffer into the final output.

methods.name: bufferEncoder
methods.description: Provides the encoder for the buffer type.

methods.name: outputEncoder
methods.description: Provides the encoder for the output type.

methods.name: toColumn
methods.description: Converts the Aggregator into a TypedColumn for Dataset operations.
